name: Money Manager
description: Runs your day-to-day money: logs spending from your messages, bank texts and Apple Pay, tracks budgets, bills and subscriptions, and tells you each morning what's safe to spend.

examples: how much on food this month

settings.label: Currency symbol
settings.help: Shown before every amount, e.g. $, ₹, € or £.

settings.label: Monthly budgets
settings.help: One per line: a category and a monthly amount, e.g. "Food 400" or "Shopping 200". Food covers groceries and dining.

settings.label: Monthly income
settings.help: Take-home pay per month. Used for your daily safe-to-spend; without it I use the sum of your budgets.

settings.label: Payday (day of month)
settings.help: The day your pay usually lands, e.g. 15.

settings.label: Bills
settings.help: One per line: name, amount, "on" the day it's due, and an optional pay link. E.g. "Rent 1800 on 1" or "Phone 45 on 15 https://pay.example.com".
